findings.subject: input
findings.summary: Input carries `unstyled` and `shadow` booleans that are chrome variants, beside a real `variant` axis.
findings.fix: Fold `shadow={false}` into the variant axis (filled/plain already drop the shadow) or a `material` axis in input.json; keep `unstyled` internal to InputGroupInput instead of public.

findings.subject: textarea
findings.summary: Textarea has `unstyled`/`shadow` booleans and no `variant` axis, so it cannot match a filled or plain Input in the same form.
findings.fix: Add the shared field `variant` axis to textarea.json and the recipe; drop the public `shadow` boolean in favour of it.

findings.subject: input
findings.summary: No field component has a hover or focus-visible baseline; focus is only checked for presence by the runtime craft rule.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/commands.ts:5; no play functions in batch stories; input-themes "focused-look" row is invalid, not focused (input.stories.tsx:343-344)
findings.fix: Add a FocusAndHover story per field (Input, Textarea, Select, Autocomplete, SearchField, InputOTP) using play() to focus via keyboard, and a hover frame, and capture baselines in 4 themes x 2 modes; rename "focused-look".

findings.subject: textarea
findings.summary: Textarea hover and focus states are not captured.
findings.fix: Same story/baseline addition as the Input finding.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: The `active` slot state (ring and fake caret) has no baseline.
findings.fix: Add a story that focuses the OTP input in play() and capture it across themes.

findings.subject: select
findings.summary: Select trigger focus-visible (a contract state), hover and disabled-item have no baseline.
findings.fix: Add focused-trigger and disabled-item frames to the visual stories.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Autocomplete hover (contract state) and input focus are not captured; disabled opacity 0.64 differs from 0.56 on Input/Select.
findings.fix: Capture hover/focus frames; align disabled opacity on one token shared by all fields (OTP uses 0.5, input-otp.css:19).

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: The `query` state (clear button shown) has no baseline.
findings.evidence: search-field.stories.tsx exports; all baselines empty or disabled
findings.fix: Add a WithQuery story (defaultValue) and capture it.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: SearchField has no Themes story, so aqua, retro and terminal are never captured.
findings.evidence: search-field.stories.tsx exports: Playground EndAddon Filled Plain FilledDark Disabled Dark
findings.fix: Add Themes (and Endpoints/ContractMetadata like its siblings) stories with baselines.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: Contract slot `search-field-input` is never rendered; the input carries data-slot="input".
findings.evidence: search-field-contract.ts:9; input.tsx:69; grep search-field-input: no hits
findings.fix: Pass data-slot="search-field-input" to InputGroupInput (or drop the slot from search-field.json); add `invalid` to the contract states since the prop exists.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: InputOTP has no `invalid` prop and exports no prop types, unlike Input, Select and Autocomplete.
findings.fix: Add `invalid` (sets aria-invalid on the hidden input) and export InputOTPProps/InputOTPSlotProps.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: AutocompletePopup ignores PortalContainerProvider, so it portals to body where Select, Popover and DropdownMenu portal into the provided container.
findings.fix: Read usePortalContainer() and pass it as the Portal container unless portalProps.container is given.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Autocomplete size values are sm/default/lg while every other field uses sm/md/lg; className lands on the input, not the group.
findings.fix: Rename `default` to `md` in autocomplete.json (keep `default` as a deprecated alias for a release) and apply className to the input group as Input does.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Autocomplete has no APG pattern binding and no keyboard verification.
findings.evidence: autocomplete contract has no accessibility field; apps/storybook/a11y/patterns.test.ts covers only Select (80-82)
findings.fix: Add a combobox-list-autocomplete pattern to ui-foundation/a11y and bind it in autocomplete.json so patterns.test.ts runs the keyboard map.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Autocomplete tests never exercise keyboard navigation, Enter-to-select, Escape or controlled value.
findings.fix: Add behaviour tests for ArrowDown/Up, Enter, Escape and controlled value/onValueChange.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Start-addon offsets are literal rems and the placeholder hard-clips without ellipsis.
findings.fix: Derive offsets from control padding/icon tokens (or reuse InputGroup); add text-overflow: ellipsis on the input.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: Autocomplete input, adornments and option rows are 32px on a coarse pointer, with no 44px hit area.
findings.fix: Floor option rows at --a63-row-min-size and give adornments the Button ::before hit area.

findings.subject: autocomplete

findings.subject: input
